images.title: 5072 in rod numerals
images.purpose: Shows 5072 in Chinese rod numerals: heng rods for thousands and tens, zong rods for units, a blank for the empty hundreds.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Four place slots in a row, headed by place names, with rod digits in three slots and one slot left blank, the number below.
images.exact_structure: Four equal slots in a row, headed in grey (#6B7280): 1000s, 100s, 10s, 1s. 1000s slot: exactly 5 horizontal rods stacked one above another, in teal (#0072B2). 100s slot: empty, outlined by a dashed reddish purple (#CC79A7) box. 10s slot: exactly 1 vertical rod on top of exactly 2 horizontal rods, in amber (#E69F00). 1s slot: exactly 2 vertical rods side by side, in teal. Under the slots, the digits 5, 7, 2 under their slots and nothing under the empty slot. Below, larger: 5072. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Rod numerals switch between vertical and horizontal rods from place to place and leave a blank for an empty place.
images.description: Shows 5072 in Chinese rod numerals: heng rods for thousands and tens, zong rods for units, a blank for the empty hundreds.
images.context: Heng 7 is one vertical rod worth 5 over two horizontal rods; zong 2 is two vertical rods.

image_decisions.why: The rod shapes and the blank place are visual, so the numeral has to be seen to be understood.
